name: Cyberpunk 2027
description: Out October 20, 2026, "Cyberpunk 2027" is That Boy Hi Hat's flagship single — and the most ambitious record in the CWI catalog to date. Produced by Kokurcho, the two-time Billboard-charting, BET Awards-nominated producer behind records for Lil Durk, GloRilla, and Duwap Kaine, and executive co-produced by Black Lansky, the track was recorded at Cue Recording Studios in Falls Church, VA, and it sounds like the budget: cinematic production on a widescreen scale. This is alternative rap as blockbuster — synth-heavy and synth-driven, layered and atmospheric, with an 808-driven undercurrent that keeps the future rooted in the streets. That Boy Hi Hat has never sounded more commanding. He moves through the dystopian landscape the track builds — neon-noir imagery, urban decay, a future that feels twelve months away rather than twelve years — with the poise of an artist who invented the lane. The mood is dark, cinematic, futuristic, and unapologetically dystopian; the hook lands like a transmission from the world the title names. As the anchor of That Boy Hi Hat's post-trap futurism era and the lead single of the Cyberpunk 2027 campaign, this is the record everything else in the catalog points toward: alt rap elevated to cinema. The future, per That Boy Hi Hat, is already here — and it knocks.
